message.content: In the US, Calm’s **consumer subscription prices** currently appear to vary by checkout channel: the app/store listings show **$14.99/month** and **$69.99/year** in some places, while Calm’s own website and several 2026 pricing trackers show **$16.99/month** and **$79.99/year**; reported **lifetime** pricing also varies between **$399.99** and **$499.99** depending on where it is purchased or displayed.[2][4][6][10] I could not verify a public US list price for **Calm Business** or **Calm Health** on a per-employee basis from the provided sources; Calm’s business/health offerings are typically sold via custom enterprise quotes rather than posted per-seat pricing, so you’d need a sales quote for current employee pricing.[3][5] Sources: Calm plans page and pricing update[2][3], Sensor Tower/App Store pricing snapshots[4], and 2026 pricing roundups[6][10].
